sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: two-year commitment and cost transparency
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our long partnership and want a sustainable agreement rather than a blanket increase. In return for a 24-month commitment at 4,000 housings per year, we propose EUR 49.13 per unit, payment 60 days net, effective 1 April 2027; lead time 35 days and FCA remain unchanged.

Please share your current full cost per housing, broken down into materials, energy, labour and overhead, together with the changes behind your request and your annual financing rate. We will use this to find a price that supports a healthy foundry; if 30-day payment materially helps, please quantify the price reduction you could exchange for it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our long-standing partnership and gladly accept your proposal for a 24-month commitment starting 1 April 2027. This concession on price and effective date reflects our dedication to finding a sustainable agreement together.

Our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.80 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: revised alternatives and sustainable margin
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for moving on price and accepting the two-year term and April start. We can raise our proposal to EUR 50.33 per unit with payment 60 days net, or EUR 49.94 per unit with payment 30 days net; both are for 24 months, effective 1 April 2027, with 4,000 units annually, 35-day lead time and FCA unchanged.

Our opening was a negotiating proposal, not a claim based on external index data. I respect the confidentiality of your detailed breakdown: could you instead confirm your total full cost per housing and financing rate, or the minimum price that would leave a 4% operating margin on each payment option? A confidential aggregate figure is sufficient to help us protect continuity without underwriting an unexplained blanket increase.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised offer; we value your commitment to our long-standing partnership. 

Please understand that as a family-run business, we treat our internal cost structures, margins, and financing rates as strictly confidential. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our margin and our limits stay internal, and while our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF, the figures stay with us.

To reach a sustainable agreement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.20 per unit for the 30-day payment option. For our full Angebot, we offer a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: narrowing the remaining gap
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. We respect your decision to keep your calculation confidential and will not ask again.

To make the 30-day payment option work, we can improve our proposal to EUR 50.62 per unit, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract effective 1 April 2027. Annual volume remains 4,000 units, with 35-day lead time and FCA unchanged.

This pairs your preferred payment terms with two years of planned demand. Can you approve this package so we can conclude the agreement?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

move.subject: PH-100: proposal to conclude
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your further concession. We are now very close, and I can make one smaller movement to EUR 50.75 per unit, payment 30 days net, for 24 months effective 1 April 2027. The annual volume of 4,000 units, 35-day lead time and FCA remain unchanged.

If you can approve this final small adjustment, we are ready to accept the matching offer and conclude our two-year agreement.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
